entities.summary: The University of the Philippines Los Baños is a public research university and a constituent university of the University of the Philippines System, primarily located in Los Baños, Laguna. Established in 1909 as the UP College of Agriculture (UPCA), it is the second oldest academic institution of the UP System and has been an early center for agricultural education and research in Southeast Asia.
